text:
Omar: FYI from today's Globex kickoff — they insist on per-tenant SLA gating + model tethering (ability to force traffic to their certified model) before we can move to pilot. They called it a security and compliance blocker.
Jules: Noted. Sounds like a combo of feature parity + policy surface. Competitor ships "model tether" and per-tenant SLA enforcement. We should map minimal acceptance criteria.
Priya: Sales asks: 1) API to tether a tenant to a model 2) ability to specify SLO thresholds (latency/cost) that trigger routing/alerts 3) daily token-by-tenant CSVs 4) an immutable audit trail for tethering changes.
Nina: Two engineering paths: implement a lightweight "tether" flag on route configs + export hooks, or full per-tenant sandboxing + scheduler. Lightweight path is doable as an alpha.
Omar: Launch criteria for Globex pilot (proposal): a) tenant tether API + console toggle b) SLO rule engine (simple thresholds) c) export of tenant/model/token usage d) p99 latency for tethered requests < 250ms e) audit events persisted and downloadable.
Jules: Perf note — naive per-request lookup and auth-time policy fetch adds ~25-60ms. Mitigations: embed tether info in tenant JWT at auth-time, or compile an in-memory map refreshed on policy change. Spike required.
Priya: Globex wants a signed pilot commitment if we can ship tether + exports within 3 weeks. They accept alpha UX and a documented roadmap to full sandboxing in Q3.
Nina: Proposal for immediate plan: Spike (Jules) 7d to validate p99 with in-memory map vs auth-time attach; Implement tether API (Nina) 1 sprint; Export hook (Priya) 1 sprint; Minimal console toggle (Omar) 1 sprint.
Omar: API sketch for tethering (alpha):
```json
POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/tether
{
  "model": "redwood/gpt-medium-v2",
  "effective_from": "2026-05-01T00:00:00Z",
  "reason": "compliance",
  "created_by": "omar@redwood"
}
```
Response returns tether_id + audit_id.
Jules: Also recommend tagging every request with telemetry: tenant_id, tethered_model (if any), routing_decision, reason_code. That will help product prioritize native features.
Priya: I'll draft Globex pilot letter with the 3-week alpha commitment and a Q3 roadmap milestone for full per-tenant sandboxing. Sales wants explicit rollback windows and an SLA hangar clause.
Nina: Security: need mTLS or signed JWT for any on-prem model endpoints if we add proxying later. For tethering, ensure policy changes are write-audited and require 2FA for prod toggles.
Omar: Owners & dates: Spike (Jules) - 7d, Tether API (Nina) - sprint, Export CSV (Priya) - sprint, Console toggle mock (Omar) - 4d, Pilot letter (Priya) - 3d.
ops-bot: staging/tether-alpha created by Nina — https://staging.internal/redwood/tether-alpha :rocket:
Jules: I'll post perf numbers in this thread after the spike. If auth-time attach wins, we can avoid touching hot request path.
Priya: Good. Booked sync Fri 11am to lock commitment or roll to de-scope. :calendar:
